what_this_is: A prior census of this market, projected back into discovery candidates and reconciled with a fresh discovery pass by street identity. Nothing here is authority: a prior row survives on its own observation or is absorbed into the fresh sighting of the same building, and every absorption is listed.

absorptions.basis: same street identity (number + street words + ZIP); the prior census carries no coordinates, so this is the only identity both records hold
